decisions.reason: Having survived the early post-launch review and fitting the firm's core trailer capabilities, this box car trailer series likely performs at or near aspiration levels, so management would keep it unless clear underperformance appears.

The high trailer cover series complements the existing trailer range and uses the same production and service network, so in the absence of evidence of a results shortfall it would likely be retained.

This box car trailer series still faces some pruning risk because of overlap within the portfolio, but if it remains on the market by 2022 management would infer that it has found a satisfactory niche and keep it for now.
